name: Eclipse Ditto
description: Digital Twin framework for IoT that provides virtual cloud-based representations of real-world devices. Mirrors physical devices as digital representations with HTTP, WebSocket, AMQP, MQTT, and Kafka APIs.

docker_support.docker_evidence: In order to start the latest built Docker images from Docker Hub, simply execute: cd deployment/docker/ docker-compose up -d

eval_notes: Mature IoT digital twin platform that scales to millions of twins. Could be used for modeling network device state, telemetry mirroring, and what-if scenarios. Microservice architecture (Policies, Things, Things-Search, Gateway, Connectivity + MongoDB + nginx).
